notes: Reader 2, independent: I expanded every bracketed number in critic-ai.md section 2 and section 5.A item A with python3 (ranges [a]-[b] inclusive, comma lists individually) and cross-checked the hand-built groups against a regex sweep of those same two sections, which agreed exactly at 238 bracketed indices with no index shared between the two sections. Rule 2 then removed the four the critic itself calls verified - one HC3 row (VERIFIED_VERBATIM) and the Holtzman 1044-1053 carve-out, which resolved against the state to exactly three rows (1046, 1047, 1048, all VERIFIED_SUBSTANCE), matching the critic's wording - leaving a raw candidate count of 234 before the state check. Each of those 234 was looked up in state-ai.json verdicts by string key, 231 came back SKIPPED_TRIAGE and are included while the other 3 are reported in notSkipped with their verdicts rather than dropped; note that "35, the NYT rows above" in 5.A carries no bracketed number inside 5.A itself (those indices sit in section 3, which this reader was told not to use), so no NYT row is claimed here.
